hooks.name: player_command_level
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Paper's VanillaCommandWrapper checks a minecraft.command node)

rust_summary: the operator level one typed command of a player runs at, which a mod may raise or lower (`native_player_command_level`).
doc_summary: `native_player_command_level(player, name, command, level)` sets the operator level one typed command of a player runs at, before the server checks it: a permissions mod raises it to grant `/gamemode` to a player of level 0, or lowers it to refuse a command (Paper's `VanillaCommandWrapper` node check). Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_command_level@.
